# Morgan

## Overview

- **Role:** author  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P16](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0016), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P4](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0004), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P18](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0018), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Morgan is a short and fat individual. His physique stands in contrast to his wife, who is described as tall and lean.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P30](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0030)_

## Personality

Morgan is a delightful conversationalist and an excellent storyteller, possessing knowledge gained from extensive travel. Her brilliant charm is complemented by a deeply kindhearted nature, marked by a genuine sympathy that easily earns the affection of others.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## History

Mrs. Charlotte E. Morgan was a famous author known for writing 'Edgewood Days', 'The Rosebud Garden', and 'Golden Keys', and lived in Toronto. She was also the aunt of [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P7](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0007), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P29](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0029), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P2](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0002), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P4](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P5](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0005), +21 more_

## Relationships

### [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--pendexter.md)

Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) is a friend and traveling companion of Mrs. Morgan. The two women visit together and are hosted by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) for a pleasant meal and a stroll through the local sights.

- Friend of — friends visiting together  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)</sub>

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

[Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) is the aunt of Mrs. Morgan. [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) brings her famous relative, along with Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), for an unexpected visit to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's home, where they are entertained before departing.

- Relative of — niece  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)</sub>
